Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site Monster Fuzz $ 179.00 1 of 2 Select option Select option THREE WEEK BUILD TIME Qty $ 179.00 Add to cart View cart ***MONSTER GREEN ON BLACK VERSION AVAILABLE NOW*** So me and my homie Dirty Donny (the amazing Pinball/Rock-N-Roll artist) were talking about doing a collab pedal and POW! Within a few hours the Monster Fuzz was born! This one came together like a bolt of lightning and has turned out insanely rad! The Monster Fuzz is a souped up Frankensteined Super Fuzz octave style fuzz. What's super rad about this one is that the VOLTS control sets the internal voltage anywhere from 4-18VDC and LOW and HIGH are low/high frequency controls so along with the SCOOP control you can get all kinds of wild Super Fuzz style tones! FUZZ is the fuzz intensity control and last but not least the VOLUME control which obviously sets the output volume level. This sucker is a beautifully disgusting Rock-N-Roll Hot Rod ready to haul ass through the Tone Zone! SPECS: 5.72" x 4.77" x 1.55" 1590XX sized enclosure, true bypass switching, common 9vdc "CENTER NEGATIVE" 2.1mm BOSS style power input. Current draw ?mA. Power supply not included. ***DO NOT USE ANY POWER SUPPLY THAT IS RATED OVER 9VDC OR DAMAGE COULD OCCUR*** TESTIMONIALS: "FUZZ GOOD!" -Frankenstein's Monster (Bavarian Alps) "What blood curdling tone!" - Count Dracula (Transylvania) "I just wanted to say: JESUS CHRIST! The Monster Fuzz lives up to its name and then some. So gnarly and awesome!...I plugged it into a slightly crispy JCM. The sound was like that horn the angels blow to kick off the Rapture. Just thick, soul-battering fuzz. So beautiful and brutal. Another triumph! " -Jermey H. (California) "I am newer to Fuzz Pedals and Monster Fuzz is so versatile that it sets the bar REALLY high for what a pedal can do. My favorite setting is cranking every knob and blowing the doors off the house. Every knob is worth turning and exploring because they all shape the sound of the pedal THAT much. It is not the knob turning where you are searching for a sound that you might use; its running into how many USABLE sounds it has. You can easily lose an hour of fuzzed out bliss. The ONLY drawback is no midi. It has SO much to offer that you would want to have 4-6 settings ready. If you have a fuzz, chances are the monster fuzz will do what the other cant. If you DONT have a fuzz: GET THIS FUZZ" -Slim (The Internet) You might also like Quick view Blower Box Bass Distortion $ 139.00 Quick view Blower Box Deluxe $ 159.00 Quick view Energizer $ 79.00 You might also like
